page_title: WER 2-1 STU | Werder Bremen v Stuttgart 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+10' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Romano Schmid and he is replaced by Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen).
90+8' The referee allows time for a substitution. Angelo Stiller will be replaced by Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart).

90+8' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal despite being in a difficult position, but his shot is intercepted by one of the defenders. It will be a corner kick for Stuttgart.
90+8' Stuttgart will take a corner kick.
90+7' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
90+6' Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
90+5' Silas (VfB Stuttgart) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
90+3' Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+3' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' Here comes a substitution. Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) is brought on as a substitute for Marvin Ducksch.
88' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
88' The attendance for today's match is 42100.
87' There's a break in play and referee Robert Schroder must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Stuttgart using VAR. This could be interesting!
85' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) is flagged for offside.
85' One of the Stuttgart players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
85' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
83' Here is a change. Nick Woltemade is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen).
83' Substitution. Leonardo Bittencourt walks off the pitch and Christian Gross (Werder Bremen) comes on as a substitute.
82' Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
81' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
79' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
79' Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
78' The game is interrupted now, Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
77' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
76' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
76' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
75' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
73' This is a yellow card! Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
71' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
71' 2 - 1 Goal! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 2:1.
70' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the middle of the target, but Michael Zetterer keeps it out.
70' Stuttgart take a short corner kick.
70' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
68' Michael Zetterer (Werder Bremen) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
68' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails a few inches over the bar!
65' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Jamie Leweling will be replaced by Silas (VfB Stuttgart).
65' Substitution. Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Atakan Karazor.
65' Flag up against Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
64' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) latched on to a cross on the edge of the box, but his strike isn't accurate at all and the ball goes way wide of the left post.
62' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
61' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michael Zetterer, who smothers the ball.
58' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
56' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
53' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
52' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
51' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
51' The ball is cleared after Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

49' 2 - 0 Goal! Romano Schmid shows great vision to find Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the left side of the goal. 2:0.
49' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom right corner, but Michael Zetterer pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
48' Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar.
47' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Sebastian Hoeness probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart). He is replaced by Chris Fuhrich.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Sebastian Hoeness probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Leonidas Stergiou. He is replaced by Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart).
46' The whistle blows and Robert Schroder starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
45+2' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!

44' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
42' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. The ball is out of play. Stuttgart will take a throw-in.
41' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.

39' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
39' A clumsy foul by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) and Robert Schroder blows his whistle. Stuttgart are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
38' None of the Stuttgart players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
37' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
35' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
33' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) dribbles into the box, but Michael Zetterer is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
32' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
31' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
29' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
28' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Alexander Nubel no chance!
28' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
27' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
26' Robert Schroder couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) and blew his whistle. Werder Bremen are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
26' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
25' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
24' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
23' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.

22' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Michael Zetterer pulls off a great save to stop his attempt towards the roof of the net. The referee signals a corner kick to Stuttgart.
21' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Stuttgart earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
20' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) commits a foul and Robert Schroder immediately signals a free kick. A free kick is awarded to Stuttgart.
19' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' What a wasted chance that is! A precise cross into the box finds Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen), whose header flies way wide of the left post.
17' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Stuttgart.
17' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
15' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
14' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
12' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
9' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
8' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

5' He should have scored! Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Michael Zetterer makes an easy save.
3' Stuttgart control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Robert Schroder.
